title: Independent audit of T74 raised-entrance wrapper bindings
body:
PR2435 raises 24 helper entrances in each of two T74 provider words. This audit connects those exact changed bytes to native helper frames, rank-seven residual recipes, and both emitted wrapper streams, then checks the resulting 12 operators with two retained independent exact kernels. It supplies the local entrance-delivery binding left outside PR2446's scalar/owner audit.

Every one of the 512 columns is covered, including global phase and zero entries: 3,145,728 complex coefficients per kernel. All 48 helper occurrences and 96 orientation bindings remain checked after operator deduplication. The source-derived interface is the same in both orientations; REVIEW.md states the logical restoration and whole-family hosting premises. It also proves why a simple orthogonal coordinate relabeling cannot realize these rank-two, Gram-rank-one entrances.

**Scope and credit.** No construction defect, new kappa, complete native supplier, full invoice, or formal/all-size proof is claimed. The wrapper mechanism is already present in Jeremy Kothe's PR2435 (`324d7d3590dc21003940a44cb0cbdc32b3620f25`), building on Vlado Vojdanovski's PR2322. Sagar Thakrar's PR1781 packed kernel and PR2029 closed-form kernel are retained unchanged; the new contribution is their binding to these changed sources and failure modes. Whole-word scalar restoration, global ownership and cost/precision obligations remain separate.

**Validation.** The registered Python3.12 replay passes under `-I -O -B`, including 72 rejected operator mutations and 12 equivalent positive controls per kernel, six binding mutations, and six behavioral tests. Fresh runs of all three pinned producer stages reproduce all six stored JSON payloads. The selected-record consistency check passes; the full selected cold replay was not run because its inputs are unchanged. A separate Git-free, read-only-file Python3.14 replay also passed in 35.825s with all 24 file hashes unchanged (local-only run log); hosted CI is a separate gate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-entrance-wrapper-audit
```

Package: `research/t74-entrance-wrapper-audit/` (24 added files only). Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; submitted head `0709b0fb1ead100a7074378dce5a601922ff8dba`. Source and generation pins, exact result receipt, and optional producer reproduction are included.

Coordination: [Discussion2463](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2463). Refreshed overlap covered 666 open PRs including drafts and 1,191 Discussion records with complete pagination, plus 1,536 local records; code diffs and arbitrary package files are outside that helper's coverage. Related PR2466 explicitly inherits entrance delivery and concerns owner fill. This is an advisory scope check, not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a mathematical frame-scheduling specialist. Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution retained. Selected-frontier records are untouched.
